evidence_set: 10 crossover studies (2009-2018), 194 healthy volunteers (97 women) aged 18 to 45 (Methods › Subjects); a single oral MDMA dose per analysed session, 125 mg (164) or 75 mg (30), as study conditions (112 of the 164 took 125 mg in two sessions, once after a medication pretreatment; only the MDMA-alone session was analysed); dose per body weight 1.7 (SD 0.4) mg/kg, range 0.8-2.7; sessions in a quiet hospital ward with at most two participants, lying in beds, mostly listening to music.
